citation.authors: Anderwald C, Tura A, Grassi A, et al.
citation.title: Insulin Infusion During Normoglycemia Modulates Insulin Secretion According to Whole-Body Insulin Sensitivity

population.description: The 65 insulin-sensitive (IS) non-diabetic subjects, in excellent health with no regular drug intake (nondiabetic metabolism confirmed by OGTT); 65% female (Table 1). IS is defined by the clamp M value (M > 5.0 mg/min/kg), so only fasting glucose, not M, is entered. 24 of the non-diabetic subjects (not split by group) were first-degree offspring of T2DM patients. Age 45 +/- 1 years and BMI 24.8 +/- 0.5 kg/m2 are means +/- SE; the SDs (SE x sqrt(65)) are computed by me. Insulin-resistant and T2DM subjects of the paper are left out.
